verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party or independent evidence of a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for Svelte. The `library` template in sv create is only a developer building block for authoring libraries, so it earns no credit. Community reports point the other way: users had to roll their own components (comm-10), struggled to find a solid UI component library (comm-20), and conceded React's larger ecosystem (comm-8).
